rec: Chronicle for teleports to south of Varrock
rewards: Access to a shortcut to the Chaos Altar

st.t: Talk to Rat Burgiss south of Varrock.
s: Shall I get them back for you?
Of course! Tell me what you need me to do.

st.t: Go to the outlaws' camp just west of the Grand Exchange and kill 5 outlaws for intel. Put the intel into the folder Rat gave you.
Return to Rat Burgiss south of Varrock.
Talk to Surok Magis in the Varrock Library.
Travel to the chaos altar with the wand and 15 chaos runes. You can either enter with a chaos talisman, or use the abyss.
Use the wand on the chaos altar.
Return to Surok Magis in the Varrock Library with the wand and a bowl.
s: I have the things you wanted!

st.t: Return to Rat Burgiss south of Varrock.
s: Yes! I have a letter for you.

st.t: Talk to Zaff in the Varrock staff shop.
Prepare to fight King Roald (level 47), then go talk to Surok Magis in the Varrock Library.
Fight King Roald. When he's almost dead and your character says "Now would be a good time to summon Zaff!", long-press the beacon ring and choose Operate.
Return to Rat Burgiss south of Varrock to finish the quest.
